items.definition:
Subject to sudden or unpredictable changes of mood or mind
Her mercurial temperament made her difficult to work with.

characterized by parts being done or made at different times or in different ways
The project was completed in a piecemeal fashion.

relating to the anterior part of the frontal lobe of the brain
The prefrontal cortex is involved in decision-making.

based on presumption; assumed to be true or valid unless rebutted
He is the presumptive nominee for the presidential election.

relating to or involving psychoanalysis
She is studying psychoanalytic theory.

making a loud and unpleasant noise
The raucous crowd cheered loudly for their team.

resembling steel in strength, hardness, or coldness
He gave her a steely gaze that showed his determination.

relating to syntax
The sentence had a complex syntactic structure.

not pretentious or arrogant; modest
Despite his success, he remained an unassuming person.

owing thanks or obligated to someone
She felt beholden to him for his kindness.

providing psychological relief through the open expression of strong emotions
Writing in her journal was a cathartic experience for her.

in a state of coma; extremely sleepy or lethargic
After the accident, the patient remained comatose for several days.

relating to gestation
The doctor monitored the patient's gestational diabetes.

not believing in God or a god
Some people consider a society without religion to be godless.

having the form of a helix; spiral
The DNA molecule has a double helical structure.

formed from molten rock
Granite is a common type of igneous rock.

unwilling or unable to believe something
She gave him an incredulous look when he told her the story.

Crude, vulgar, or sexually explicit
The comedian's raunchy jokes made some audience members uncomfortable.

unwieldy
The large box was unwieldy and difficult to carry.

vertebral
The doctor examined the patient's vertebral column.

relating to the tooth sockets or lung air sacs
The 't' sound in English is an alveolar stop.

deprived of or lacking something
After losing his dog, he felt utterly bereft.

abstaining from sexual relations; pure
The novel described a chaste and innocent love story.

tending to meet at a point; coming together
The two research teams reached convergent conclusions despite working independently.

relating to the origin and development of the universe
Scientists are studying the cosmological implications of the new discovery.

relating to the skin or dermis
The cream is designed for dermal application to soothe irritated skin.

able to be run or carried out
The file is an executable program.

(of weather) unpleasant, cold, or wet
The game was postponed due to inclement weather.

showing luminous colors that seem to change when seen from different angles
The soap bubble had a beautiful iridescent sheen.

relating to language or the tongue
The lingual nerve affects taste and speech.

full of vigor; robust; healthy and strong
The choir sang with a lusty enthusiasm.

having many aspects or sides
Her job is multifaceted, involving many different skills.

taken to prevent something
The government launched a preemptive strike.

relating to the arrangement of the natural and artificial physical features of an area
The topographical map showed all the hills and valleys.

lacking originality or freshness; overused
His speech was full of trite remarks and clichés.

better than everyone or everything else
Her talent for painting is unrivalled.

clever; full of wiles; cunning
The wily fox managed to escape the trap.

relating to actuaries or their work of calculating insurance risks and premiums
She works in the actuarial department of an insurance company.

made in a traditional or non-mechanized way using high-quality ingredients
They sell artisanal cheeses at the local market.

fickle; unpredictable
The weather in spring can be very capricious.

cancer-causing
Smoking is known to be carcinogenic.

having a common axis or center
The television uses a coaxial cable for its antenna connection.

relating to Euclid's geometry
Euclidean geometry is the study of plane and solid figures based on axioms and theorems.

irrelevant or unrelated
Please remove any extraneous details from your report.

containing iron
Steel is a ferrous alloy, meaning it contains iron.

relating to herbs, especially non-woody plants
Many garden plants are herbaceous, meaning their stems are soft rather than woody.

deceptive; based on illusion
His sense of security proved to be illusory.

too extreme to bear; intolerable
His arrogance made him insufferable to be around.

having equal dimensions; relating to muscular contraction without shortening
Isometric exercises involve holding a position without movement.

measly (contemptibly small or few)
He complained about the measly portion of food he received.

moronic (very foolish or stupid)
His moronic comments angered everyone in the room.

multidimensional (having many different sides or characteristics)
The problem was multidimensional, requiring solutions from various fields.

neoclassical (relating to a revival of a classical style or treatment in art, literature, architecture, or music)
The building's neoclassical facade featured tall columns and symmetrical design.

omnipresent (present everywhere at the same time)
In the digital age, smartphones have become an omnipresent part of our lives.

relating to a palace or to a powerful feudal lord; relating to the palate
The Palatine Hill is one of the seven hills of Rome.

(of an action) seeming sensible and judicious under the circumstances
It was not politic to mention the controversial topic at the meeting.

surpassing all others; very distinguished in some way
He is the preeminent expert in his field.

relating to or affecting the senses rather than the intellect
The artist created a sensuous painting with rich colors.

of the highest quality or degree
Her performance was truly superlative.

relating to woods or forests
The cabin was nestled in a sylvan setting, surrounded by trees.

relating to the first period of the Mesozoic era
Dinosaurs first appeared during the Triassic period.

not expressing regret
He was unapologetic about his decision, believing it was the right thing to do.

super; ultimate; supreme
He considers himself an über-fan of the band.

ring-shaped
The eclipse was annular, leaving a ring of sunlight visible.
